Execute.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT(T.TRANSACTION_ID), T.LAST_MODIFIED_DATE, T.ORDER_COMPLETE_DATE, T.PF_SOURCE_CLIENT, B.PF_BATCH_ID FROM CRLTRANSACTION T INNER JOIN TRANSACTION_TEXT R ON T.TRANSACTION_ID=R.TRANSACTION_ID LEFT JOIN BATCH B ON (T.PF_SOURCE_CLIENT = B.PF_SOURCE_CLIENT) WHERE (( T.LAST_MODIFIED_DATE > T.CREATED_DATE AND T.ORDER_COMPLETE_DATE IS NULL AND ( T.LAST_STATUS_DELIVERED_DATE IS NULL OR T.LAST_STATUS_DELIVERED_DATE < T.LAST_MODIFIED_DATE ) ) OR ( T.ORDER_COMPLETE_DATE IS NOT NULL AND ( T.FINAL_RESULT_DELIVERED_DATE IS NULL OR T.FINAL_RESULT_DELIVERED_DATE < T.ORDER_COMPLETE_DATE ) )) AND ( T.FINAL_RESULT_STAGED_DATE IS NULL OR T.FINAL_RESULT_STAGED_DATE < T.LAST_MODIFIED_DATE ) AND ( T.PF_PROCESSING_KEY IS NULL OR (sysdate - to_date(PF_PROCESSING_KEY, 'YYYY-MM-DD-HH24-MI_SS')) >= (4.0 / 24.0) ) AND T.PF_SOURCE_CLIENT IN ('MLFE')
